Pro costs €8 per user per month when billed annually, or €10 per user per month when billed monthly. It adds unlimited projects, timelines and guest access.
Yes, every new workspace starts with a 14-day Pro trial, and no credit card is needed.
The Free plan allows up to 5 members, along with 3 projects and 1 GB of storage.
You can download past invoices as PDF from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Only owners and billing admins can do this.
To add your VAT ID to invoices, go to Settings > Billing > Invoices and edit the billing details there. The change applies to future invoices only; invoices that were already issued can't be changed.
No, we don't accept PayPal. We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express, and annual Business plans can also pay by SEPA direct debit.
To update your card, go to Settings > Billing > Payment method in your workspace. We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express.

You can cancel at any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Your workspace keeps its paid features until the end of the current billing period, then moves to the Free plan, and nothing is deleted.

Yes, if you cancel an annual plan within the first 30 days, you get a pro-rata refund to your original payment method within 5-10 business days. After that window, the documents don't say whether a refund is available, so please reach out to the team through the "Talk to a human" option for that case.
Yes, registered nonprofits get 50% off Pro and Business. You can apply with the discount form and proof of your status; approval takes about 3 business days.

Yes, students get Pro for free for personal use while they have a valid university email address. Nonprofits, schools and universities can also get 50% off Pro and Business by applying with the discount form and proof of status.

Yes, Taskline supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on with Okta. SCIM provisioning can also create and remove members automatically, and owners can enforce SSO so members can no longer sign in with a password.
Yes, members can be provisioned automatically. SCIM provisioning creates and removes members for you, and it's available alongside SAML single sign-on for business workspaces.

To turn on two-factor authentication, go to **Profile > Security**. You can use an authenticator app or a hardware security key (WebAuthn / passkey). Be sure to save the ten recovery codes somewhere safe, since they are the only way back in if you lose your phone.

I'm sorry you're locked out. If you saved your ten recovery codes, you can use one of them to get back in. You can also turn on two-factor authentication again later under Profile > Security. If you don't have the codes, reach out to the team using the "Talk to a human" option.
Your workspace data is stored in the European Union, in Frankfurt (AWS eu-central-1), with encrypted backups in Ireland. It is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.
Yes. Taskline signs a GDPR data processing agreement (DPA) with every paid customer on request. Workspace data is stored in the EU, in Frankfurt, with encrypted backups in Ireland.
We guarantee 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits if we miss it, on the Business plan. You can check live status and incident history at status.taskline.example.
Planned maintenance happens on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 CET, and the team announces it 72 hours ahead. You can check live status and incident history at status.taskline.example.

To reset it, click "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter your email. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If the email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or ask an admin to confirm the address on your account. If your workspace uses single sign-on, reset your password through your identity provider instead.

Only the workspace owner can delete it. Go to Settings > Workspace > Delete workspace. Deletion cancels any paid plan immediately, and the workspace can be restored for 30 days. After that, all projects, tasks and files are permanently erased, so export your data first if you want to keep a copy.
A deleted workspace can be restored within 30 days of deletion. After that, all projects, tasks and files are permanently erased, so export your data first if you want to keep a copy.
Guests only see the projects shared with them. They can comment on those projects and complete tasks assigned to them, but they can't create projects.

To invite a client, open the project, click **Share**, and enter their email. This works on the Pro and Business plans, and guests are free: they only see that project, can comment and complete tasks assigned to them, and don't count as paid seats.
No, guests never count as paid seats. On Pro and Business, you can invite clients and freelancers as guests at no extra cost.
Yes, you can import Trello boards. Go to Settings > Import, and assignees, due dates, comments and attachments are copied over. Attachments larger than 100 MB are skipped.
The maximum size for a single uploaded file is 250 MB.
When your workspace storage is full, existing files stay available, but new uploads are blocked until you free up space or upgrade your plan.

Admins can export the whole workspace from Settings > Export, as JSON or CSV. The export includes tasks, comments and file links, and the export link is emailed to you and stays valid for 7 days. A single project can also be exported to CSV from its project menu.
Yes. Use the /taskline command or the message shortcut in Slack to turn any message into a task. You can connect Slack from Settings > Integrations.

Yes. When a pull request linked to a task is merged, the task moves to Done automatically. To link them, include the task ID (for example TL-123) in the branch name, commit message or pull request title.
The REST API allows 100 requests per minute per personal access token. Above that, the API responds with a 429 status and a Retry-After header.
Each webhook request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 and the signature is sent in the X-Taskline-Signature header. To verify it, check that signature against your webhook secret on your endpoint.
Yes, the Taskline mobile app works offline. You can create and update tasks while offline, and your changes sync once you're back online.
Press **C** to create a task. You can press **?** anywhere to see the full list of keyboard shortcuts.
Pro is €10 per user per month when billed monthly. If you pay annually instead, it's €8 per user per month.
To add a guest, open the project, click **Share**, and enter their email address. Guest access is available on Pro and Business plans.

Aboneliğinizi Ayarlar > Faturalandırma > Planı iptal et adımından istediğiniz zaman iptal edebilirsiniz. Çalışma alanınız mevcut fatura döneminin sonuna kadar ücretli özellikleri korur, ardından Ücretsiz plana geçer ve hiçbir şey silinmez.

Yıllık planınızı ilk 30 gün içinde iptal ederseniz, kalan süre için kısmi geri ödeme alabilirsiniz. Bu geri ödeme, ödeme yaptığınız yönteme 5-10 iş günü içinde yapılır. İptal için **Ayarlar > Faturalandırma > Planı iptal et** adımlarını izleyebilirsiniz. Aylık planlarda geri ödeme yapılmamaktadır.

İki adımlı doğrulamayı Profil > Güvenlik sayfasından açabilirsiniz. Bir doğrulayıcı uygulama ya da donanım güvenlik anahtarı (WebAuthn / geçiş anahtarı) kullanabilirsiniz. Kurulumdan sonra verilen on kurtarma kodunu güvenli bir yere kaydetmeniz önerilir, çünkü telefonunuzu kaybederseniz hesabınıza dönmenin tek yolu bu kodlardır.

Giriş sayfasındaki "Şifremi unuttum" bağlantısına tıklayıp e-posta adresinizi girin. Sıfırlama bağlantısı 30 dakika geçerlidir; e-posta gelmezse istenmeyen klasörünüze bakmanızı öneririz. Çalışma alanınız tek oturum açma kullanıyorsa, şifrenizi kimlik sağlayıcınızdan sıfırlamanız gerekir.
